vo.text: This rock was once alive. Want to know how?
How does a dinosaur turn into stone?
Long, long ago, a big, gentle dinosaur lived right here, munching ferns by the river.
One day, very old and very tired, it lay down by the water, and fell asleep forever.
The river brought mud and sand, and tucked its bones in, like a blanket.
Then more mud came. And more. Layer on layer, for millions and millions of years.
Deep down, water crept into the bones and left tiny bits of stone behind. Slowly, slowly, the bones became rock.
Then wind and rain wore the land away, little by little.
Until one sunny day, a girl with a little brush found something poking out of the ground.
A fossil! A real dinosaur, turned to stone.
I wonder what is sleeping under your feet.
